subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the N52 across all 2 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The N52 in the Z4 E89 sDrive23i and sDrive30i — two variants spanning a single generation.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, complete gasket and seal set, timing chain components where required.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported pattern is confirmed for the N52 across its Z4 applications. We don't treat this engine as having one universal failure mode; diagnosis is required to establish whether an engine needs repair, rebuild or replacement.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed N52 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
